Anritsu.why: Its Test & Measurement business sells evaluation and manufacturing-test instruments to optical transceiver makers (BERTWave MP2110A for 400GE/800GE/1.6TE modules, optical spectrum analyzer for CPO laser evaluation); AI data-center demand in the optical transceiver market drove T&M revenue +34% in Q1 FY2026.
Anritsu.evidence: Anritsu Q1 FY2026 results presentation (07-30-2026): 'In the T&M business, data center-related demand, such as in the optical transceiver market, remained strong due to the spread of AI'; Q&A: 'We have received orders for both 800GE and 1.6TE related products.'

players.product: Optical transceiver test instruments: BERTWave MP2110A (400GE/800GE/1.6TE module manufacturing test), MP1900A Signal Quality Analyzer, MS9740B optical spectrum analyzer for CPO/LD evaluation

quarterly_data.quarter: Anritsu results presentation: Financial Results for the 1st quarter FY2026 (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2026 (April-June 2026): orders 49.1 billion yen (+95% YoY), revenue 32.6 billion yen (+38%), operating profit 4.3 billion yen (+219%; 13.1% margin). T&M revenue 19.4 billion yen (+34%) and operating profit 3.2 billion yen (16.3% margin) as data center-related demand, such as in the optical transceiver market, remained strong due to the spread of AI and customer investment deferred by US tariff policies recovered; Network Infrastructure was 50% of T&M Q1 revenue
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 revenue 32.6 billion yen; T&M revenue 19.4 billion yen (+34%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Anritsu results presentation: Financial Results for the 1st quarter FY2026 (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company view: in data centers for generative AI the upgrade to 800GE networks is gaining full steam and optical transceiver manufacturers are ramping up production of 800GE optical transceivers; development of 1.6TE optical transceivers is progressing with efforts begun with a view to mass production, and preparations have begun for 3.2T optical transceiver development; network equipment makers are accelerating PCIe Gen7 development. Its roadmap shows 1.6TE mass production, CPO mass production and 3.2TE development ahead
